description: A resuming session inherits a `## Resume` block whose `As of` runs to 600 characters and carries three facts the block has no room for: the audit's finding, a pair of ingest measurements, and the two unanswered asks. Every lane already has a short name in the `name` column. The facts have to leave the block, and the cell they must not land in is `name` — the only cell the board draws on a bar and in the lane table.
